# Hempdustry 2

> Hempdustry 2 (formerly GanjaCraft) is a free, open-source cannabis mod for Minecraft Java Edition on Fabric and NeoForge, for Minecraft 1.21.11 and 1.21.1. You grow weed (cannabis, marijuana, hemp) in fields, grow pots or hydro trays, smoke it in a spliff, pipe, bong or vaporizer, sift and press it into hash and rosin, cook edibles from cannabutter, and build with hempcrete, hemp bricks and hemp planks. It is designed as a Vanilla+ mod: everything is meant to feel like Mojang shipped it. Current version: 2.1.0, stable (October 2026). Made by Warlon Mhite.

## Facts

- Game: Minecraft Java Edition only. No Bedrock or Pocket Edition.
- Loaders: Fabric (needs Fabric API) and NeoForge (needs nothing else), since 2.1.0. Install on client and server.
- Minecraft versions: 1.21.11 and 1.21.1. The 1.21.1 builds lack the Hemp Shelf, the Hemp Harness and canvas bundles.
- License: code AGPL-3.0, art and music CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Free, nothing paywalled. Allowed in modpacks, monetized ones included.
- Languages: 12 (English US/UK/CA/AU/NZ, French FR/CA/CH, German DE/AT/CH, Russian). Russian does not cover 2.1 yet.
- Optional: JEI and REI recipe pages on both loaders, EMI on 1.21.1. Server owners can switch off every drug effect in config/hempdustry.json and keep only industrial hemp.
- Worlds from any Hempdustry 2 version open on every later one.

## What's in 2.1.0

- Three strains: Purple Kush (2 blocks tall, jungles, swamps, lush caves), Lemon Haze (3 blocks tall, savanna to badlands) and Beldía (a Moroccan landrace from the Rif that grows on sand near water; wild on desert riverbanks). Shear plants to trim them. Bees pollinate, chickens and parrots eat seeds, goats eat leaves, creepers sometimes hide in grown fields.
- Indoor growing: Grow Pot (water bottle + bone meal, 1.5x a good field), Grow Lamp (two extra buds per plant), Hydro Tray (water, fertilizer and a redstone-powered pump, 2x the best field). Losing light or water while flowering stresses a plant; stressed plants lose buds and spoil some into schwag.
- Smoking: spliff, wooden pipe, bong (16 stained-glass colors plus tinted, can be set down, hold to draw) and Redstone Vaporizer (gentle, never greens you out). Purple Kush gives Resistance, Lemon Haze Speed and Haste, Beldía Invisibility, hash Night Vision, each with downsides and munchies. Over-smoking can green you out.
- Hash: Sifting Box (dry sift to kief, or an ice-water wash to bubble hash), Hemp Press (heated screw press: hashish, filtered hashish, rosin), charas rubbed off ripe plants, moon rocks, hash bars you cut with a sword. No BHO.
- Kitchen: Decarboxylator oven, cauldron rinse, Infuser, real cannabutter. Six edibles: space cookie, space brownie, space cake, cannabutter toast, dawamesk, bucket of bhang. Delayed onset like real edibles. Plus non-psychoactive hemp foods: toasted hemp seeds, hemp seed bar, hemp milk, siemieniotka.
- Building: hempcrete, hemp bricks, full fireproof hemp wood set (doors, fences, signs, boats, shelf), hemp parquet, canvas and hemp wool that replace leather and wool, Hemp Bed, Hemp Harness for the happy ghast, canvas bundles, a hemp leaf banner pattern. A dyeable hemp outfit that lasts like leather.
- Extras: 42 advancements, seven paintings, two original music discs by Nefuß, datapack-defined strains, datapack machine recipes, addon events on both loaders.

## Coming later (ideas, no dates)

Warped Kush and Crimson (Nether strains), Ruderalis, Industrial Hemp and Ditchweed. Someday: custom High and Munchies effects with tolerance, a hemprepreneur villager, a pillager dealer's hideout.
